---

governess, would-be contributor to MP

She was governess to the children of Philip Wynter,  president of St Johns College Oxford in 1861.

She was evidently daughter of the Rev.

Richard Garnett (1789-1850), assistant keeper of printed books at the British Museum, and sister of Richard Garnett (1835-1906), keeper of printed books at the British Museum,  for she was staying with the latter in the 1871 census and still a governess.
